faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

refundPolicy.question: What is the refund policy?
refundPolicy.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee if you're not happy with our product.

cancelSubscription.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
cancelSubscription.answer: You can cancel your subscription by visiting the billing page.

changePlan.question: Can I change my plan?
changePlan.answer: Yes, you can change your plan at any time by visiting the billing page.

freeTrial.question: Do you offer a free trial?
freeTrial.answer: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial.

whatIsShipAny.question: What is this product?
whatIsShipAny.answer: It is a development framework for quickly building AI SaaS products. It comes with rich built-in modules and components, ready to use out of the box.

noCode.question: Can I use it without coding knowledge?
noCode.answer: This product is mainly designed for users with some development experience. If you are familiar with basic web development concepts, you can get started quickly.

whatCanBuild.question: What types of AI SaaS can I build?
whatCanBuild.answer: You can build AI writing tools, AI image generators, AI chatbots, subscription-based SaaS, and more. Core features like multi-tenancy, payments, and authentication are all supported.

howLong.question: How long does it take to develop a project?
howLong.answer: Thanks to the rich pre-built modules, most developers can launch an MVP within a few days to a week, saving months compared to building from scratch.

infrastructure.question: What infrastructure is included?
infrastructure.answer: The framework includes authentication, database, payments, email, storage, i18n, admin panel, and more — all ready to use out of the box.

customization.question: What customization options are available?
customization.answer: All code is fully open. You can freely modify themes, UI components, business logic, and integrate any third-party services.

dataSource.question: Where does KOLArena's data come from?
dataSource.answer: KOLArena aggregates public market data, on-chain data, and trading views publicly posted by KOLs, then organizes and backtests them through a unified metric system.

beginnerFriendly.question: Is your platform suitable for beginners?
beginnerFriendly.answer: Yes. The platform provides visual rankings, signal tracking, and backtest results, so beginners can start with key metrics such as win rate, returns, and drawdown.

backtestMetrics.question: What backtest metrics does the platform provide?
backtestMetrics.answer: The platform shows core metrics such as win rate, cumulative return, maximum drawdown, signal frequency, and profit-loss ratio to help users evaluate strategy quality.

planDifference.question: What is the difference between the Free and Pro plans?
planDifference.answer: The Free plan is for trying the basic experience. Pro includes more complete real-time market data, aggregated KOL K-line tracking, real-time signal pushes, and dedicated support.

lifetimePlan.question: Does the platform offer a lifetime plan?
lifetimePlan.answer: Yes. The Lifetime plan is designed for long-term users. Pay once and keep the corresponding benefits without monthly renewal.
